purpose: Compile frozen P0-A/P0-B/P0-C receipts into deterministic next-state and claim-lock annotations without executing, authorizing, or repairing any experiment.
primary_rules: P0-A GO may make frozen P0-B eligible only through a separate governed execution gate; the compiler never launches it.
P0-A qualified STOP disables P0-B/P0-C as primary rescue and disables the current full STRI method experiment.
P0-A qualification/budget failure produces no scientific belief update and does not authorize automatic retry.
P0-A one-witness inconclusive forbids adaptive extra generations, threshold changes, and second-backbone rescue.
P0-B must bind to the exact P0-A raw SHA and use zero new model calls/GPU hours.
P0-B STOP kills the current SQC realization/full progression even if P0-C is positive.
P0-B PASS only marks local quotient feasibility; it does not authorize the full experiment.
P0-C is secondary and can never rescue or override P0-A/P0-B progression.

claim_policy.C1: supported before P0 from two released control-plane systems
claim_policy.C2: supported before P0 from real support graph plus theorem/reductions
claim_policy.C3: locked until all full primary method gates pass
claim_policy.C4_realized_task_distribution: may be annotated as supported only by qualified P0-A GO
claim_policy.C4_end_of_evolution_or_utility: remains locked until P0-C/full evidence and claim-scope review
